description: This file defines the HealthStore class and associated data structures used for monitoring and managing health status within the OpenClaw application. It includes data models for snapshots, state enumeration, singleton management, refresh logic, and auxiliary functions for decoding and status interpretation.

classes.name: HealthSnapshot
classes.description: Data model representing a snapshot of health status, including channel summaries, session information, and metadata.

classes.name: HealthState
classes.description: Enumeration representing various health statuses with associated UI presentation details.

classes.name: HealthStore
classes.description: Singleton class managing the health monitoring process, including data refresh, state assessment, and error handling.

methods.name: __setSnapshotForTest
methods.description: Test-only method to set snapshot and error state directly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the periodic health refresh loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic health refresh loop.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Performs an on-demand health data fetch and updates internal state.

methods.name: isChannelHealthy
methods.description: Determines if a channel is considered healthy based on its configuration and probe status.

methods.name: describeProbeFailure
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of a failed health probe.

methods.name: resolveLinkChannel
methods.description: Finds the primary linked channel in the current snapshot.

methods.name: resolveFallbackChannel
methods.description: Finds an alternative healthy channel if the linked one is problematic.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the failure state based on the snapshot.
